{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
target_group = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check if any such rows exist
assert len(target_group) > 0, 'No NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH found — contradicts premise.'

# Count total number of such customers
total = len(target_group)

# Count how many of them converted (converted == 1)
converted_count = target_group['converted'].sum()

# Compute fraction converted
fraction_converted = converted_count / total

# Output
fraction_converted"}
